subject: dsa
title: Jump Game
summary: Sweep left to right tracking the farthest index reachable so far. If an index ever sits beyond that reach you're stuck; if the reach covers the last index, you win.
problem: Each value is the maximum forward jump from that index. Starting at index 0, can you reach the last index?

steps.caption: Each value is the most you can jump forward from that index. Starting at index 0, can you reach the last index?
Track the farthest index reachable so far. From index 0 you can jump 2, so reach = 2.
Index 1 is within reach. From it you can jump 3, extending reach to 1 + 3 = 4.
Reach is now 4, the last index. Every index up to here was reachable, so the end is reachable too.
So yes, the last index is reachable (e.g. 0 -> 1 -> 4). Had reach ever fallen behind the current index, we'd be stuck and return false.
